source_note: matklad's ARCHITECTURE.md format: a short bird's eye view, a codemap that names files and symbols to search for instead of linking them, architecture invariants, and cross-cutting concerns. The with side adds a 96-line root ARCHITECTURE.md written from the current code in base/frai (what frai does, the four packages and their dependencies, entry points and bins, where tests and dist live, and that docs/architecture-target.md describes a plan, not the code) plus the prompt prefix 'Read ARCHITECTURE.md before you start.' The without side has no file and no prefix; neither side has a CLAUDE.md, and both keep the existing docs/ folder. Every statement was checked against the code. Re-checked against the four hard prompts and reference patches: as a codemap it names the files the hard tasks touch (validate.ts, key-store.js, detectors.js, generateReport and reporters.js, the frai-agent tools), as any codemap of this repo would, but it describes none of their mechanisms: no field or label parsing, NEEDS HUMAN INPUT handling, thresholds or exit codes, .env reading or writing, root versus subcommand options, import matching, library list or file extensions. The run-helper example was changed from runScanCommand/runEvalCommand to runGenerateFlow/runRagIndexCommand. Task set and model changed on 15 Sep 2026 after the pilots (see PROTOCOL): t1, t2, t3 and h2 on Haiku 4.5, both sides.
